frame.description: Poses of the Mid-360 mounting plate (its bottom face) in the imported body frame of body_mock. The deck top face is z = 0; the deck occupies z in [-0.023, 0], x in [-0.143, 0.143], y in [-0.223, 0.223]. Per packages/hexapod_core/hexapod_core/frames.py the anatomical forward direction is body -Y, lateral is body +X and up is body +Z, so a rotation about body X is the anatomical pitch.
frame.sensor_axes: Sensor local +Z points out of the mounting plate, through the optical window. The optical centre lies 25.92 mm along +Z from the plate.
frame.rpy_deg: Extrinsic roll-pitch-yaw about body X, Y, Z applied in that order.

mounts.name: deck_center_upright
mounts.note: Bolted flat to the deck top at the geometric centre. The reference case.

mounts.name: phase3_current_assumption
mounts.note: The mount already assumed by isaaclab/hexapod_phase3/sensor_cfg.py, whose lidar_pos_b_m places the optical centre 75 mm above the deck top. Plate height is that minus the 25.9 mm optical-centre offset.

mounts.name: deck_center_mast_075
mounts.note: Lowest upright mast at which the legs and frame block none of the below-horizon band at the Stage2C stance.

mounts.name: deck_front_upright
mounts.note: Flat on the deck, as far forward as the 65 mm footprint allows.

mounts.name: deck_front_overhang
mounts.note: On a bracket ahead of the front deck edge, plate 30 mm below deck top.

mounts.name: deck_center_pitch20_m060
mounts.note: 60 mm mast, optical axis pitched 20 deg forward-down.

mounts.name: deck_center_pitch40_m060
mounts.note: 60 mm mast, optical axis pitched 40 deg forward-down.

mounts.name: deck_center_pitch60_m060
mounts.note: 60 mm mast, optical axis pitched 60 deg forward-down.

mounts.name: deck_center_inverted_m120
mounts.note: Inverted on a 120 mm mast. Violates the Livox 0.5 m inverted ground-clearance notice on this robot; evaluated for reference only.

mounts.name: deck_front_inverted_over
mounts.note: Inverted on a bracket ahead of the front deck edge. Same Livox notice applies.
